overview_description.description:
New Story is a non-profit organization that pioneers solutions to end global homelessness.

New Story creates a more inclusive housing market for low-income families. To shape that market, they rely on innovative solutions and incentivized partners. Through three core interventions, they ensure housing solutions are fair, affordable, and dignified.

Founded by Mike Arrieta and Alexandria Lafci in 2014 and is located in Atlanta, GA.
